newsitem.title: USA: U.S. NRC agrees to oversee Energy Dept nuke sites.
newsitem.headline: U.S. NRC agrees to oversee Energy Dept nuke sites.

text.p: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Monday it had agreed to take over responsibility for overseeing the Energy Department's nuclear facilities.

The Energy Department proposed last December to transfer oversight of its nuclear sites to the NRC to give the public more confidence in its activities, including the cleanup of contaminated former weapons production and testing sites, and maintenance of the nation's nuclear stockpile.
Comments from the public strongly supported the request, the NRC said.
The commission backed the plan, which requires approval from Congress, "contingent on adequate funding, staffing resources, and a clear delineation of the authority NRC would exercise."
The Energy Department estimated that external regulation would cost about $135 million annually and planned to ask Congress to transfer oversight to the NRC over 10 years.
